shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat surface
justification: A depicts a figural scene, a bearded human leading a bridled horse in profile with additional legs below a groundline, while B depicts purely ornamental registers of rosettes, palmette-like plants and a scalloped lower border. The only real correspondence is the shared use of horizontal registers separated by ruled lines in shallow relief, which is a generic device; there is no shared motif, no shared figural content and no comparable relationships between elements.
